平三卓盯着盒子，听着王野的推测。不过一会儿就说：“小野，要不咱爷俩儿试试？”

王野等的就是这一句，他知道有，可是他不能说呀！要是他说：“师父，我知道这里是微雕的最后三针，是什么什么的。”

不说平三卓信不信，把他当成个妖怪是肯定的。虽然妖怪和妖孽是一字之差，但那可是天差地别。妖怪是要切片的，妖孽是被保护的。

王野说：“师父，最多不过是个盒子，真要是搞坏了，我给你找个金丝楠的去。”

平三卓一巴掌拍在王野后脑勺上：“我差你一个木头盒子呀！你就说怎么搞。”

王野说：“师父，你给我那根银针。”

平三卓从椅子上站起来让王野坐下，说：“抽屉里就有。”

王野打开抽屉拿出一根最短银针。

王野拿起银针又想到，这也不能直接开整呀，他的眼睛也不是放大镜呀，转头又问：“师父，有放大镜吗？”

平三卓没好气的说：“你说，你还要什么，我一次给你找齐。”

王野赶紧说：“不用别的了，不用别的了。”

平三卓出去了一下，没一会儿就又回来了，递给王野一个放大镜。王野一手拿着放大镜，一手拿着银针，开始了一顿忙活。

平三卓在旁边看着王野就那么拿着针点一点，然后吹一下，接着点，接着吹，看得平三卓都要发飙了。

王野直了直身子说：“师父，搞定了。”

平三卓赶紧凑了上去，可是他那老花眼什么也看不见，急不可耐的问王野：“小野，这上面是什么呀？”

王野赶紧把放大镜放到特定的位置，平三卓又在放大镜中观看。

这一看，老头差点没背过气儿去，虽然仍不是很清晰，但是大概也看见了，这就是他辛辛苦苦半辈子找的夺命三针。

平三卓指着盒子结结巴巴的说：“这.....这......这就是，就是夺命....夺命三针。”

王野赶紧轻抚着平三卓的后背说：“师父，冷静，冷静。”

平三卓坐在凳子上，双手捧着盒子。不停的摇头，嘟囔。王野离得这么近也没听清平三卓嘟囔的什么。应该是埋怨祖上的人这么重要的信息没传下来。

过了好半天，平三卓才缓过来，对着王野说：“徒弟呀，师父是沾了你的运气呀！要不然，为师一辈子也解不开这夺命三针的迷呀！”

王野说：“师父，这都是缘分，您老不收我，我都见不到这盒子，更别说这个了。”

平三卓点着头说：“对，就是缘分，咱爷俩是命中注定的师徒。”

王野听见这话多少有点沮丧，人家命中注定的不是紫霞吗，自己怎么命中注定个老头子。

接下来，王野就把盒子上的微雕抄录下来递给平三卓。王野说：“师父，你慢慢研究吧，等你研究明白记得教给我啊！”

说完就悄悄的出了书房。到了院里，跟师娘打了声招呼，就出了平三卓家。

正要回家的王野突然想到了一件事情，上个周末的时候，是不是答应陈洛兮要给她做好吃的。

这下王野着急了，这一周王野把这件事儿忘的一干二净。今天都星期六了，明天陈洛兮肯定会找来。总不能做个红烧肉，炒个土豆丝。

这东西对于老百姓来说，是过年才能吃的上的好东西的。可是对于陈洛兮，那就是家常菜。再说了，人家要吃的是谭家菜。

不行了，必须找外援了。王野第一个想到的就是何雨柱，可是轧钢厂有个屁呀！王野要的是鲍鱼，鱼翅，海参，是熊掌，燕窝。轧钢厂最多有点猪肉，鸡肉。

Ping Sanzhuo stared at the box and listened to Wang Ye's speculation.But after a while he said: "Xiaoye, how about we try it?"

This was what Wang Ye was waiting for. He knew it was there, but he couldn't say it!What if he said: "Master, I know here are the last three stitches of the microcarving and what they are."

Regardless of whether Ping Sanzhuo believed it or not, he was definitely regarded as a monster.Although there is a word difference between monster and evildoer, they are worlds apart.Monsters are to be cut into pieces, and monsters are to be protected.

Wang Ye said: "Master, it's just a box at most. If it gets damaged, I'll find you a golden one."

Ping Sanzhuo slapped Wang Ye on the back of the head: "I'll give you a wooden box! Just do what you say."

Wang Ye said: "Master, give me that silver needle."

Ping Sanzhuo stood up from the chair, asked Wang Ye to sit down, and said, "It's in the drawer."

Wang Ye opened the drawer and took out the shortest silver needle.

Wang Ye picked up the silver needle and thought, this can't be opened directly, and his eyes are not magnifying glasses. He turned around and asked: "Master, do you have a magnifying glass?"

Ping Sanzhuo said angrily: "Tell me what else you want, and I'll find it for you at once."

Wang Ye quickly said: "No need for anything else, no need for anything else."

Ping Sanzhuo went out for a while, then came back after a while and handed Wang Ye a magnifying glass.Wang Ye held a magnifying glass in one hand and a silver needle in the other and started working hard.

Ping Sanzhuo watched from the side as Wang Ye just clicked a little with the needle, then blew, then touched, and then blew. Ping Sanzhuo almost went crazy.

Wang Ye straightened up and said, "Master, it's done."

Ping Sanzhuo hurried up, but he couldn't see anything with his presbyopic eyes. He asked Wang Ye impatiently: "Xiaoye, what is up here?"

Wang Ye quickly put the magnifying glass in a specific position, and Ping Sanzhuo looked in the magnifying glass again.

At this sight, the old man almost lost his breath. Although it was still not very clear, he probably saw it. These were the three life-threatening needles that he had worked hard to find for half his life.

Ping Sanzhuo pointed at the box and stammered: "This...this...this is the life-threatening...three life-threatening needles."

Wang Ye quickly stroked Ping Sanzhuo's back and said, "Master, calm down, calm down."

Ping Sanzhuo sat on the stool, holding the box in both hands.He kept shaking his head and mumbling.Wang Ye was so close and couldn't hear clearly what Ping Sanzhuo muttered.He should be blaming his ancestors for not passing down such important information.

After a long time, Ping Sanzhuo came to his senses and said to Wang Ye: "Apprentice, Master is lucky to you! Otherwise, I will never be able to solve the mystery of these three life-threatening needles in my entire life!"

Wang Ye said: "Master, this is all fate. If you don't accept me, I won't be able to see this box, let alone this one."

Ping Sanzhuo nodded and said, "Yes, it's fate. We are destined to be masters and disciples."

Wang Ye was a little frustrated when he heard this. Wasn't Zixia destined for others? Why was he destined to be an old man?

Next, Wang Ye copied the miniature carving on the box and handed it to Ping Sanzhuo.Wang Ye said: "Master, please study slowly. When you understand it, remember to teach me!"

After saying that, he quietly left the study.When he arrived at the courtyard, he said hello to his wife and left Ping Sanzhuo's house.

Wang Ye, who was about to go home, suddenly thought of something. Last weekend, had he promised Chen Luoxi to cook delicious food for her?

Now Wang Ye was anxious. This week Wang Ye completely forgot about this matter.Today is Saturday, Chen Luoxi will definitely come tomorrow.You can't make braised pork and stir-fry shredded potatoes.

For the common people, this is a good food that can only be eaten during the Chinese New Year.But for Chen Luoxi, it was home cooking.Besides, what people want to eat is Tan’s food.

No more, we must find foreign aid.The first thing Wang Ye thought of was He Yuzhu, but there was something wrong with the steel rolling mill!What Wang Ye wants is abalone, shark's fin, sea cucumber, bear's paw, and bird's nest.The rolling mill has at most some pork and chicken.
